g.text: Uniform settlement translates a structure; differential settlement changes its geometry

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Illustrative settlement shapes, amplified and not predicted from a soil model. Uniform settlement gives similar foundation movement; differential settlement can
rotate/distort a structure and stress connections. Compressible-layer thickness, stress increase, drainage, consolidation and foundation rigidity determine real
settlement. No permissible movement is assigned.
